# IKPyKit Docs

> Python library for Isolation Kernel Toolkit.

IKPyKit implements Isolation Kernel methods for anomaly detection, clustering, and representation learning, over points, graphs, groups, streams, trajectories, and time series. The estimators follow the scikit-learn API.

## Getting started

- [Welcome to IKPyKit](https://isolationkernel.github.io/ikpykit/0.4.0/index.md)
- [How to install](https://isolationkernel.github.io/ikpykit/0.4.0/quick-start/how-to-install.md)
